releases.displayName: Our First Update – Quality of Life & Fixes

items.text: First of all, we would like to thank you all for your support and, most importantly, for all the feedback you've been sending us since launch. We’re reading everything. This BioEden’s first update couldn’t have been made without you!
So, thank you. Seriously. ❤️
For this first update, we decided to focus mainly on quality-of-life improvements and fixing bugs that emerged during the first weeks after launch.
Made remaining unexplored hexes easier to find.
Added the River Cleaner to the tutorial, allowing players to clean 100% of the map.
Fixed rounding issues with animal requirements.
Fixed the exclamation mark sometimes remaining visible after purchasing the final level of the Biome Knowledge Tree.
Fixed outer terrain flashing while placing buildings.
Fixed rounding issues with the percentage of explored land.
Added missing control prompts for modifying Temperature and Humidity Device parameters.
Fixed multiple issues with animals when two large Dens are placed very close to each other, no more flying Scroftusk!
Fixed multiple issues occurring when cancelling the relocation of a Dome asset with a controller.
Crisis popups can now be closed without waiting for the dialogue behind them to finish.
Fixed an issue where closing the Save menu immediately after creating a save could prevent further manual saves from being created or loaded.
Fixed inconsistent behaviour of the Animal Incubator material requirement tooltip.
Fixed the camera becoming stuck on the Y axis when selecting an asset inside the Dome.
Fixed animals being releasable without being on the Release tab of the Animal Den.
Fixed the Slink missing its Biome icon during a specific mission.
Fixed a potential framerate drop or crash when moving an asset over another asset inside a Biome.
Fixed the Water Cleaner icon sometimes failing to update when a lake reached 100% cleanliness.
Fixed storage information not appearing in newly built Food Factories and Feeders.
Fixed the red Energy icon remaining visible after connecting a Water Cleaner system to an Outpost Antenna.
And other minor fixes.
Fixed and improved a slew of localization related issues
This is our first update, but definitely not our last.

There are bigger topics in your feedback that obviously can't be addressed with a quick bug-fixing update like this one. We are listening to those too. We just want to take the time to understand them properly before talking about what comes next.
For now, please keep sending us your thoughts, weird bugs, suggestions and stories from your planets!
They really do help us make BioEden better.
Thank you for being part of this journey, Keepers. 🌱
Yves
